added_lines: today, sunday 21st june the church across ireland celebrates day for life in the theme of the humanity of the unborn child which invites us to reflect on the wonder of how life from the moment of conception. we remember how the lord jesus christ himself sanctified and experienced the beginning of life in the womb of mary, mary knew that she was carrying the son of god - god and man - as soon as he was conceived. john the baptist leapt in his mother elizabeth’s womb when mary greeted her. our lady treasured our lord in her heart and womb until his birth. to read full bishops’ message visit councilforlife.ie

our invitation to reflect on sundays has emerged from the ideas of synodality - communion, participation, and mission - reminding us that it is not a personal moment which christ is about to enable but an experience where all of us are the people of god. sundays are an essential part of worship. we go to god together. the sunday mass where the church is most visibly alive, and where every member of the community plays an essential role, is clear - this participation is needed for the church to truly live.
